AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Color (Albino)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Pale pigmentation produces a white fish with a faint pink cast.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Color (Melanistic)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Excess pigmentation gives the fish a much darker coloration.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Color (Toxic Green)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: The fish has an unnaturally vivid green coloration.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Color (Anima)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: The fish carries a luminous violet coloration reminiscent of anima flora.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Color (Xanthic)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: The fish has a bright yellow xanthic coloration.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Color (Erythristic)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: The fish has a vivid reddish-orange coloration.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Variegated (Spotted)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Contrasting spots appear within the painted Spotted mask for this fish texture.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Variegated (Striped)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Contrasting stripes appear within the painted Striped mask for this fish texture.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Scale (Giant)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This specimen is substantially larger than normal.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Scale (Miniature)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This specimen is substantially smaller than normal.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Size (+%)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish is larger than its normal age and species size.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Nutritious (+%)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish and the meat processed from it provide additional nutrition.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Iridescent
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Its surface shifts through vivid colors with a shimmering sheen.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Pearlescent
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A soft rainbow sheen rolls across pale, pearl-like scales.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Metallic
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Reflective scales give the fish a polished metallic appearance.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Heavy-Bodied
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A deep, heavy body yields more meat but moves slowly through a pond.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Slender
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A narrow body moves quickly through a pond but yields less meat.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Glass
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Translucent flesh and scales give this fish a glass-like appearance.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Gilded
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: Brilliant golden scales cover this fish.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Livebearer
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish gives birth directly to live fry rather than laying eggs.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Prolific
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish becomes ready to breed again more quickly.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Seasonal Breeding (Spring)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish breeds only during spring.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Seasonal Breeding (Summer)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish breeds only during summer.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Seasonal Breeding (Fall)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish breeds only during fall.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Seasonal Breeding (Winter)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish breeds only during winter.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Solitary
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish avoids schooling and moves independently.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Curious
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish approaches colonists who stop to watch its pond.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Hardy
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This fish tolerates a substantially wider range of water temperatures.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Age (Fry)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A newly hatched fish at one quarter of adult visual size.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Age (Juvenile)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A growing fish at sixty percent of adult visual size.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Age (Adult)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A fully grown fish capable of breeding.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Age (Elder)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: An old fish near the end of its natural lifespan.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Sex (Male)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A male fish, able to breed with an adult female of the same species.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Sex (Female)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: A female fish, able to produce eggs with an adult male of the same species.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Diet (Herbivore)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species primarily grazes pond algae.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Diet (Omnivore)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species eats algae, detritus, and smaller pond life.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Diet (Carnivore)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species must prey upon smaller pond fish or receive prepared feed.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Diet (Detritivore)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species feeds primarily on organic detritus in the pond.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Diet (Filter Feeder)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species filters suspended algae and organic matter from pond water.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Water (Freshwater)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species requires a freshwater pond.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Water (Saltwater)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This species requires a saltwater pond.

AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.label: Water (Brackishwater)
AquacultureFishing.FishTraitDef.description: This adaptable species tolerates freshwater, saltwater, and brackishwater ponds.
